subject: Clearwave renewal forecast — stage refresh & churn flag nudge
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Clearwave renewal forecast — stage refresh & churn flag nudge

Team — quick operational nudge on Clearwave (renewal due FYQ4). Finance asked us for a clean commit number tomorrow so they can finalize the Q4 reserve. Please action the items below by EOD Wed 9/16 (COB PT):

1) Stage hygiene: Only mark as "Commit" if we have signed PO or confirmed payment terms + billing contact. If it’s pending procurement, leave as "Contract in progress" and note the blocker.
2) Probability adjustments: if you change probability by >15pp, update the ARR line item in the forecast CSV and add a churn-risk tag (LOW / MEDIUM / HIGH) with a one-line rationale.
3) Churn-risk criteria: a) procurement timeline >60 days, b) finance headcount freeze noted, c) open legal SOW redlines. If any apply, mark at least MEDIUM.
4) Owner & next touch: please add owner and next-touch date in HubSpot (link below) and drop the latest MAP into the Drive folder.

Attachments: forecast_snapshot_2026-09-14.csv, Clearwave-MAP-v1.pdf
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/67890
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bClearwaveForecast

I will coordinate with Finance after you update the sheet — goal is a clean number for the AR regen on Thu. Call out anything you want me to escalate to the CRO.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

- I reviewed the renewal MAP and made a couple of edits (attached as Clearwave-MAP-v2.pdf).
- Clearwave indicated yesterday their billing preference may shift to annual invoicing vs quarterly (finance team to confirm). That could delay procurement sign-off until invoice cadence is settled.
- Current probability on the record is 60%. Given the billing uncertainty and a potential hiring freeze flagged by their Ops lead (see reply below if it comes through), I recommend we move to 45% and tag churn-risk: MEDIUM for now.

I’ll:
- Update the forecast CSV with revised probability & ARR lines.
- Set myself as deal owner in HubSpot and add a one-line rationale.
- Schedule a 30-min sync with Clearwave for Wed afternoon (tentative) to confirm procurement timeline.

Attachments: Clearwave-MAP-v2.pdf

From: Sara Lynch <sara.lynch@clearwave.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 10:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clearwave renewal forecast — stage refresh & churn flag nudge

Hi Marissa / Marcus / Naomi — thanks for the heads-up. Short update from Clearwave: our CFO is reviewing headcount and vendor spend this week; there is a chance they defer a handful of renewals pending budget clarity.

We still intend to move forward with Redwood for the product, but procurement has asked for: (1) an annual invoice option, (2) a short PO draft to circulate internally, and (3) confirmation on data residency options for a portion of our workloads.

I’ve attached a draft PO (purchase_order_draft.docx) which our procurement manager will use to start the internal workflow. I’ll confirm the invoice cadence once I have the CFO’s guidance (likely later this week).

Appreciate the proactive follow-up — please keep the MAP updated and we’ll aim to narrow the timeline.

Best,
Sara Lynch
Head of Operations, Clearwave Inc
sara.lynch@clearwave.com
Attachment: purchase_order_draft.docx

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clearwave renewal forecast — stage refresh & churn flag nudge

Thanks for the visibility team — updated the record and flagged as requested. Summary of actions I completed: 

- HubSpot: deal owner = Marissa Cole; probability moved to 45%; stage set to "Contract in progress" (not Commit). Added note: "CFO budget review; procurement requested annual invoice option. PO draft received 9/15."
- Forecast: attached the clean snapshot for Finance (forecast_snapshot_2026-09-16.csv) with ARR adjusted and churn-risk: MEDIUM tag on the Clearwave line.
- Finance: pinged them to hold a provisional reserve for this account pending CFO decision; advised not to include in hard commit total until PO signed.
- Next touch: scheduled 30-min sync with Clearwave for Wed 9/16 3:30pm PT (meeting invite sent).

Related links: HubSpot deal https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/67890; DocuSign MAP https://www.docusign.com/link/CLW-MAP-2026
